Logan / Laura / Marissa —

Thanks for flagging. Below is proposed fallback language and rationale that balances our operational risk with EagleFin's reputational concerns. Suggest sending this as a tracked redline.

Proposed contract language (high level, for redline):
1) Publicity and Trademark Misuse: Either party will not use the other party's trademarks or logos for marketing or press announcements without prior written consent. In the event of alleged unauthorized use, the alleged infringing party will (i) promptly remove the content upon receipt of written notice, (ii) within ten (10) business days provide a written plan to remediate and (iii) where remediation is delayed or withheld, be liable for documented, direct remediation costs reasonably incurred by the non-breaching party. The remedy above is in addition to any equitable relief (including injunctive relief) available at law.

2) Limitation of Liability — publicity carve-out: Except for liability arising from (a) the parties' respective obligations under the Intellectual Property Indemnity, or (b) intentional and grossly negligent misrepresentation, the Parties agree that liability is capped at the greater of (i) USD [cap amount] or (ii) the total fees paid in the prior 12 months. Notwithstanding the foregoing, liability for documented remediation costs and a contractual liquidated damages amount specifically attributable to an intentional, material publicity/trademark breach will be recoverable up to a separate fixed amount of USD 250,000.

3) Consequential / reputational damages: Consequential and speculative damages remain excluded except where recoverable under the express publicity carve-out above (i.e., documented remediation costs and the contracted liquidated damages).

Rationale: this gives us a bounded, predictable exposure for willful publicity misuse (helps procurement avoid open-ended reputational risk) while protecting Redwood from unlimited reputational claims. The separate $250k pot is negotiable (we can push lower or tie it to Order Form value).

If everyone is comfortable with the approach, I can prepare a tracked changes redline for the MSA and a short comment blurb for the Order Form explaining the negotiated cap/exception. If Sales needs a higher number or to link the liquidated damages to ARR, let me know.
